canonical_name: Lyapunov indirect or linearized stability theorem family
candidate_family_not_credited_as_stateme: For a source-selected nonlinear dynamical system at an equilibrium, transfer a source-selected stability or instability property from the linearization under the exact differentiability, well-posedness, spectral, domain, and boundary hypotheses selected by that source.
statement_blocker: The catalog supplies only 'stability by linearization'. It does not choose finite-dimensional ODE versus Banach-space semigroup, the system and solution model, regularity and well-posedness, equilibrium, derivative or generator, spectral hypothesis, Lyapunov/asymptotic/exponential conclusion, stable versus unstable direction, or critical-spectrum boundary. Selecting, conjoining, or weakening a standard variant would add proposition-changing mathematics.
domain_and_universes: Open: an exact source must fix continuous or discrete time, finite-dimensional or Banach phase space, scalar field, topology and norm, state domain, nonlinear system, equilibrium, solution or semigroup representation, and all universes and typeclass assumptions.
conclusion: Open: the repository does not choose Lyapunov, asymptotic, or local exponential stability, instability, one spectral direction, or the conjunction of stable and unstable directions.
degenerate_case_status: No case is excluded at intake because no proposition is selected; every listed trivial, boundary, nonunique, and critical-spectrum case must be resolved by the statement phase.
candidate_scope_not_credited: finite-dimensional negative-spectrum branch yielding local exponential stability of an equilibrium
finite-dimensional positive-spectrum branch yielding instability of an equilibrium
a combined finite-dimensional two-direction indirect-method theorem
Banach-space transfer from exponential stability or instability of a linearized semigroup under Frechet differentiability and well-posedness
a weaker formulation concluding only asymptotic or Lyapunov stability
degenerate_cases_to_resolve: zero-dimensional phase space, zero vector field, constant field, and an already-linear system
equilibrium at zero versus an arbitrary equilibrium and the checked coordinate translation
non-isolated equilibria and equilibrium sets rather than a single equilibrium
nonunique, nonmaximal, finite-time, or boundary-approaching solutions
spectrum on the imaginary axis, zero eigenvalues, Jordan blocks, and the no-conclusion critical case
empty, residual, continuous, or essential spectrum in infinite-dimensional variants
local versus global trajectory domains and exact forward-time endpoint conventions
excluded_substitutions: THM-M-1343 Lyapunov direct method or existence of a Lyapunov function
THM-M-1355 stability of the linear system alone
local ODE existence, uniqueness, differentiability, or spectral infrastructure alone
a stability predicate assumed as structure data or projected from an assumption
a critical-axis conclusion inferred without source-specific higher-order hypotheses
the untrusted catalog status treated as source or kernel evidence
